provider: Microsoft Teams (free / personal) - Gallery & Media uploads

free_tier.stated: 5 GB OneDrive-backed file storage per user, BUT images and videos uploaded via Gallery/Media are explicitly NOT stored in OneDrive and have no storage limit

egress.terms: Free; media served from Microsoft's CDN, chat-attached files via OneDrive share links

tooling: No public Teams-free file API; attachments land in OneDrive, so Graph API against the backing OneDrive is the usable path. Wrapper-only for the media path.
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited free Microsoft accounts (OneDrive-backed); separately the media path is per-record unlimited - 'share as many photos and videos as you want' - which is the interesting half: an image/video album with no byte cap, multiplied by unlimited free accounts.
limits_note: 250 GB max per individual file in OneDrive (personal); 100 MB per file in the Teams channel Files UI; media path takes images/video only, no arbitrary binaries; chat history limits are separate from file limits
reliability_note: The media path has no documented retention guarantee and no API - it is UI-only, so it is a manual archive at best; the 5 GB OneDrive ceiling hits almost immediately.

evidence.proved: 'The amount of free storage... is 5 GB. Images and videos are not saved on OneDrive and don't have a storage limit. You can share as many photos and videos as you want.'
'5 GB of cloud storage per user' (free) vs '1 TB of cloud storage per user' (paid)
'File upload limit (per file) | 250 GB'; SharePoint-backed 'Up to 25 TB per site or group' on licensed plans

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
